data.title: Terrebonne bike path to be dismantled this winter
data.description: It's decided: a portion of the Terrebonne bike path will be dismantled this winter and will be replaced by parking spots. Daybreak reached out to Notre-Dame-de-Grâce residents to get their opinion on this decision.
